question: Should AXorcist use the official OpenClaw tap, and should its initial formula build from tagged Swift source or install prebuilt release artifacts?
rationale: Both paths satisfy the request but impose different toolchain, signing, architecture, release-automation, and long-term ownership requirements that repository evidence cannot choose safely.

options.title: Official source formula
options.body: Add AXorcist to the official tap with a checksum-pinned tagged source formula that builds the Swift executable, minimizing new release infrastructure.

options.title: Official binary formula
options.body: First produce versioned signed binaries for supported macOS architectures, then have the official tap install and verify those artifacts.

options.title: Defer official packaging
options.body: Retain the documented SwiftPM/manual installation path until someone owns the tap and release pipeline.

recommendation.title: Official source formula
recommendation.body: Add AXorcist to the official tap with a checksum-pinned tagged source formula that builds the Swift executable, minimizing new release infrastructure.

likelyOwner.reason: Their AXorcist release history and connection to the official Homebrew tap make them the best available owner for this distribution choice.
